State Ownership and Cost-effectiveness of Environmental Policy: Firm-level Evidence
abstract: We employ Chinese firm-level data to examine the interconnections among firm ownership, environmental regulation, and non-environmental economic policies. We find that there are substantial differences between state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and privately-owned enterprises (POEs) in response to government anti-pollution mandates. SOEs reduced emissions more than POEs, with the former relying mainly on abatement investment and the latter on reducing outputs. An average POE’s marginal abatement cost is more than nine times that of an average SOE, suggesting significant inefficiencies in policy implementation. Policies liberalizing financial markets could affect POEs’ abatement costs and improve the cost-effectiveness of environmental policies.
abstract_zh: 我们利用中国企业层面数据，考察企业所有权、环境规制与非环境经济政策之间的相互关联。我们发现，国有企业与私营企业在应对政府减排强制要求方面存在显著差异。国有企业的减排量多于私营企业，前者主要依靠减排投资，后者则主要依靠减少产出。一家普通私营企业的边际减排成本，是一家普通国有企业的九倍以上，这表明政策执行存在显著的低效率。放松金融市场管制的政策可能影响私营企业的减排成本，并提高环境政策的成本有效性。

title: The interaction of financial incentives and social norms to motivate conservation on the Tibetan Plateau
Too Much of a Good Thing: Lessons from Compromised Rootworm Bt Maize in the U.S. Corn Belt
Eliciting Time and Risk Preferences of Farmers
venue: Journal of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association
abstract: We jointly elicit the time and risk preferences of farmers using a survey. Assuming risk neutrality (linear utility), we estimate a mean annual discount rate of 15.3%, which falls to 4.2% when accounting for risk preferences. Most farmer characteristics have an insignificant relationship with time and risk preferences, except that the percent of income from farming has a negative relationship with risk aversion. Time and risk preferences also show no significant relationship with irrigation intensity. These findings are informative for agricultural decision‐making, as production often involves delayed and uncertain payoffs, and can help guide conservation policy design and promote sustainable practices.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项调查联合测度了农民的时间偏好和风险偏好。假设风险中性（线性效用），我们估计平均年贴现率为15.3%，在考虑风险偏好后降至4.2%。大多数农民特征与时间偏好和风险偏好之间没有显著关系，但农业收入占总收入的比例与风险厌恶呈负相关。时间偏好和风险偏好与灌溉强度之间也没有显著关系。这些发现对农业决策具有参考价值，因为农业生产往往涉及延迟且不确定的收益，并且有助于指导保护政策的设计，促进可持续实践。

title: China's Climate Policies: Climate Targets and Implementation Mechanisms
abstract: China leads the world in both greenhouse gas emissions and renewable energy deployment. In recent years, China has committed to increasingly ambitious climate goals and is on track to meeting these goals. This article provides a systematic review of China's climate policies and their impacts. We argue that China's climate policies can be classified into two components: binding climate-related targets and a mixture of command-and-control and market-based implementation mechanisms. We discuss how the mechanisms have performed and the lessons they offer for the future climate policies of China and other countries.
abstract_zh: 中国在温室气体排放和可再生能源装机方面均居世界前列。近年来，中国承诺实现日益宏大的气候目标，并且正按计划推进这些目标。本文对中国的气候政策及其影响进行了系统回顾。我们认为，中国的气候政策可分为两个组成部分：具有约束力的气候相关目标，以及命令—控制型与市场型实施机制的组合。我们讨论了这些机制的运行表现，以及它们为中国及其他国家未来的气候政策提供的经验教训。

title: Groundwater Institutions in the Face of Global Climate Change
abstract: We review the literature on the performance of groundwater institutions, including command-and-control (CAC) approaches, market-based institutions (MBIs), and voluntary approaches, and evaluate how they will perform as agriculture adapts to climate change. Both CAC approaches and MBIs lead to uneven distributional impacts on farmers, and voluntary approaches have not been successful in reducing water withdrawal on a large scale. A polycentric approach of regulation plus local management might perform well. Climate change will increase the irrigation demand for groundwater and demand flexible and properly scoped institutions that attend to local conditions.
abstract_zh: 我们回顾了地下水制度绩效的相关文献，包括命令—控制（CAC）方法、市场型制度（MBIs）和自愿性方法，并评估随着农业适应气候变化，这些制度将如何表现。命令—控制方法和市场型制度都会对农民产生不均衡的分配影响，而自愿性方法在大规模减少取水量方面并不成功。兼顾规制与地方管理的多中心方法可能表现良好。气候变化将增加地下水的灌溉需求，并要求建立灵活、范围适当且能够顾及地方条件的制度。

title: Knowledge Protects Against Pollution: The Health Effects of the Cadmium Rice Event in China
Financial incentives for behavior change at the intersection of human, animal, and ecosystem health: A One Health perspective
Heterogeneous effects of food safety risk information on consumer preferences for rice
Adaptation and the Distributional Effects of Heat: Evidence from Professional Archery Competitions
abstract: We examine the distributional effects of high temperature on worker performance and the effectiveness of adaptation when capital investments such as air conditioning are not feasible. Using a longitudinal data set of 3196 professional archers in 57 competitions during 2010–2016 in China, which includes accurate performance measures at the individual‐by‐contest level, we show that heat causes more uneven performance distributions by hurting the bottom performers more than the top performers. More frequent heat reduces average performance and raises distributional inequality more than increases in average temperature. Gaining experience and long‐term acclimatization together can mitigate 70% of the heat impacts, demonstrating the potential of adaptation.
abstract_zh: 在空调等资本投资不可行的情况下，我们考察高温对工人绩效的分配效应，以及适应措施的有效性。利用2010–2016年间中国57场比赛中3,196名职业射箭运动员的纵向数据集（该数据包含个体×比赛层面的准确绩效指标），我们发现高温会造成绩效分布更加不均，因为它对表现最差者的伤害大于对表现最好者的伤害。与平均气温的上升相比，更频繁的高温会降低平均绩效，并更大程度地加剧分配不平等。获得经验与长期适应能够共同缓解70%的高温影响，显示了适应的潜力。

title: Aggregate Emission Intensity Targets: Applications to the Paris Agreement
abstract: We develop the concept of aggregate emission targets, which are cost effectively implemented national emission goals, and welfare rank expected‐emission‐equivalent aggregate emission intensity, quantity, and price targets. As targets become more stringent, it is more likely that the intensity target dominates the quantity target. A higher correlation between a country's gross domestic product and emission intensity favors aggregate intensity over price and quantity targets. Concerns about global welfare favor the aggregate quantity target. Applying the ranking conditions to the top 12 CO2 emitting nations, we obtain a robust finding that aggregate intensity targets dominate quantity targets for most of them.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了总体排放目标的概念，即以成本有效方式实施的国家排放目标，并对期望排放当量下的总体排放强度目标、总量目标和价格目标进行福利排序。随着目标日趋严格，强度目标更有可能优于总量目标。一国国内生产总值与排放强度之间的相关性越高，总体强度目标相对于价格和总量目标就越具优势。对全球福利的关注则有利于总体总量目标。将排序条件应用于排放二氧化碳最多的12个国家，我们得到一个稳健的结论：对其中大多数国家而言，总体强度目标优于总量目标。

title: Culture and Social Norms: Behavioral Decisions about Grassland Conservation among Ethnically-Tibetan Pastoralists
venue: Journal of International and Intercultural Communication
abstract: Conceptions of what is typical (descriptive norms) and socially appropriate (injunctive norms) are constrained by culture. Based on interviews with Tibetan pastoralists in Western China, we examine social norms and behaviors associated with managing domesticated animals. We describe the ways that behavioral decisions are influenced by interpersonal communication and observation of norms, along with ecological, market, and policy forces. Explicit communication about norms occurs primarily under problematic conditions, in times of change or policy introduction. Findings reinforce the relevance of understanding the culturally bound dimensions of social norms and the need to ground theory and research on social influence in intercultural communication concepts.
abstract_zh: 关于何为典型的（描述性规范）以及何为社会上可接受的（指令性规范）的观念，受到文化的制约。基于对中国西部藏族牧民的访谈，我们考察了与家畜管理相关的社会规范和行为。我们描述了行为决策如何受到人际沟通和对规范的观察所影响，同时也受到生态、市场和政策力量的影响。关于规范的明确沟通主要发生在问题突出的情况下，即在变革或政策出台之时。研究结果表明，理解社会规范中具有文化约束的维度十分重要，并且有必要以跨文化传播的概念为基础，构建关于社会影响的理论与研究。

title: Navigating and Evaluating the Labyrinth of Environmental Regulation in China
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: We examine the development of China’s environmental regulatory system over nearly 50 years and review economic studies of its effectiveness. China’s environmental regulation system has evolved over time into a complex and multilayered labyrinth. However, studies in the economics literature tend to focus on a few policies that span periods for which data are available and that allow causal identification. While the literature suggests that the policies have been generally effective in improving environmental quality, it also reveals several challenges for conducting empirical analyses: a firm’s regulatory status is frequently endogenous, data quality is variable, although improving over time, and overlapping policies may undermine traditional identification approaches. Further research is needed to comprehensively evaluate the cost-effectiveness of China’s environmental regulations, identify the interactions of multiple policies, and extend the analyses beyond water and air to also include soil and other types of pollution.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了中国近50年来环境监管体系的发展，并回顾了关于其有效性的经济学研究。中国的环境监管体系随时间演变，已成为一个复杂的多层级“迷宫”。然而，经济学文献往往只关注少数几项政策，这些政策覆盖的时期有可用数据，并允许进行因果识别。尽管文献表明这些政策总体上有效改善了环境质量，但它也揭示了开展实证分析时面临的若干挑战：企业的监管状况常常具有内生性，数据质量参差不齐（尽管随时间有所改善），而相互重叠的政策可能削弱传统的识别方法。未来仍需开展进一步研究，以全面评估中国环境监管的成本效益，识别多项政策之间的相互作用，并将分析范围从水和空气扩展到土壤及其他类型的污染。

Environmental Regulation: Lessons for Developing Economies in Asia

title: Real Options and Environmental Policies - the Good, the Bad, and the Ugly
abstract: The literature on real options shows that irreversibilities, uncertainties about future benefits and costs, and the flexibility in decision making generate benefits and costs of delaying immediate action. When applied to government policy making, real option models can lead to efficient policies that take full account of these trade-offs, but they can also cause strategic behavior that tries to delay policies through influencing important elements such as downside risks. This contribution reviews the latest developments in real option–based policy research by looking at what we know about the benefits from waiting (the good), the costs from waiting (the bad), and how strategic behavior can influence policies (the ugly). Much has been said in the literature about the good and the bad, but more work is needed to study the ugly aspects of real option–driven policies.
abstract_zh: 实物期权文献表明，不可逆性、对未来收益与成本的不确定性，以及决策中的灵活性，会产生推迟立即行动所带来的收益与成本。应用于政府政策制定时，实物期权模型可以得出充分考虑上述权衡的有效政策，但它们也可能引发战略性行为，即通过影响下行风险等关键要素来试图推迟政策出台。本文综述了基于实物期权的政策研究的最新进展，考察了我们对等待的收益（好的方面）、等待的成本（坏的方面），以及战略性行为如何影响政策（丑陋的方面）的已有认识。文献中对好与坏的方面已有大量讨论，但仍需更多研究来探讨实物期权驱动的政策中“丑陋”的一面。

title: Characterizing Interpersonal Influence for Grassland Conservation Behaviors in a Unique Population
Rebound Effects of New Irrigation Technologies: The Role of Water Rights
abstract: We study how institutions such as water rights can complement new irrigation technologies in promoting the sustainability of U.S. agriculture. Using data from the Ogallala‐High Plains Aquifer region of Kansas, we find that water extraction moderately increases after adopting Low Energy Precise Application (LEPA) irrigation, and this rebound effect is in general higher for farmers with larger water rights. About half of the LEPA's rebound effects arise because adopters tend to irrigate more land and grow more water‐intensive crops, with the remaining half attributable to more intensive irrigation. Farmers with greater water rights use more water, with two‐thirds of the effects arising from irrigating larger land areas, and one‐third of the effects attributable to more intensive irrigation. A 10% reduction of water rights will reduce water use by 5% in the long run, and if the reduction targets the majority of the water rights, which lie between 100 and 500 AF, LEPA's rebound effect decreases by 15.4%. Finally, we find that farmers have an incentive to apply a small amount of water in order to preserve their water rights, but the associated water waste is insignificant.
abstract_zh: 我们研究水权等制度如何与新型灌溉技术相互补充，以促进美国农业的可持续性。利用堪萨斯州Ogallala—高平原含水层地区的数据，我们发现采用低能耗精准灌溉（LEPA）后，地下水抽取量有所增加，并且这种反弹效应总体上在拥有更多水权的农民中更高。LEPA的反弹效应中，约一半源于采用者灌溉了更多土地并种植了更多耗水作物，其余一半则归因于更加密集的灌溉。拥有更多水权的农民用水更多，其中三分之二的效应来自灌溉更大的土地面积，三分之一的效应来自更密集的灌溉。水权减少10%，长期内将使用水量减少5%；如果削减的目标是大多数介于100至500英亩-英尺（AF）之间的水权，则LEPA的反弹效应将降低15.4%。最后，我们发现农民有动机少量用水以保全其水权，但由此产生的水浪费微不足道。

title: Long-Term Effects of Payments for Environmental Services: Combining Insights from Communication and Economics
abstract: Interdisciplinary analytical perspectives can bring important insights to address complex sustainability problems. In this paper we present and apply a model that integrates perspectives from economics and communication sciences to address the question of what happens to pro-environmental behavior after the introduction and then the withdrawal of payment for environmental services (PES). In particular, we discuss the effects of financial incentives on social norms and the effects of norms on subsequent behavior after incentives have ended. This is important because the dominant literature on PES lacks a sophisticated understanding of social norms and fails to address what will happen to behavior once payments end. That literature addresses the potential problem that payments can crowd out or possibly crowd in intrinsic sources of motivation for pro-social behavior, but it lacks the sophisticated understanding of social norms that has the potential to help explain and address this phenomenon. We summarize experimental evidence based on our model showing that introducing a financial incentive for behavior change can change social norms around that behavior. These norms, in turn, can continue to influence behavior even after incentives have ended. PES programs can address this situation by actively evoking existing social norms in favor of conservation.
abstract_zh: 跨学科的分析视角能为应对复杂的可持续性问题带来重要洞见。本文提出并应用了一个整合经济学与传播学视角的模型，用以探讨在引入、随后撤销环境服务付费（PES）之后，亲环境行为会发生什么变化。具体而言，我们讨论了经济激励对社会规范的影响，以及规范在激励结束后对后续行为的影响。这一点很重要，因为关于PES的主流文献对社会规范缺乏深入理解，也没有探讨付费结束后行为将如何变化。该文献讨论了付费可能挤出（crowd out）或挤入（crowd in）亲社会行为内在动机的潜在问题，但缺乏对社会规范的精细理解，而这种理解有可能帮助解释和应对这一现象。我们总结了基于本模型的实验证据，表明引入经济激励以改变行为，可以改变围绕该行为的社会规范。这些规范反过来可以在激励结束后继续影响行为。环境服务付费计划可以通过积极唤起既有的、有利于保护的社会规范来应对这一情况。

title: Moving toward sustainable farming systems: Insights from private and public sector dialogues on nitrogen management
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: A gricultural systems face the challenge of increasing production to meet growing global demand for food while protecting the natural resource base in a changing climate. Major environmental challenges include rebuilding soil health after centuries of heavily extractive production systems, improving water and air quality, and contributing to climate change mitigation (Robertson 2015). These resource problems are diffuse and pervasive, resulting from the decisions of individual farmers who are struggling to balance production with environmental protection. Moreover, public policies in the United States promote large-scale monoculture production and heavy reliance on industrial inputs through direct subsidies and insurance options that limit farmer choices (Iles and Marsh 2012; Stuart and Gillon 2013). Meeting these challenges requires a multipronged and multilayered approach: actions by thousands of individual farmers supported by research into new approaches, education about emerging practices and technologies, and policies that promote sustainability. These types of challenges have been described as wicked problems (Batie 2008) because they are dynamic, complex, and occur in both technical and social dimensions as compared to problems with straightforward causes and effects that are largely solvable through technical solutions. In the agri-environmental context, wicked problems arise because farming is both an ecological and a socioeconomic process.
abstract_zh: 农业系统面临的挑战在于：在气候变化背景下，既要提高产量以满足全球日益增长的粮食需求，又要保护自然资源基础。主要的环境挑战包括：在数百年高强度汲取式生产之后重建土壤健康，改善水质和空气质量，以及为减缓气候变化作出贡献（Robertson 2015）。这些资源问题分散且普遍存在，源于个体农民的决策，而他们正艰难地在产量与环境保护之间寻求平衡。此外，美国公共政策通过直接补贴和保险选项，促进大规模单一作物生产以及对工业投入品的严重依赖，从而限制了农民的选择（Iles and Marsh 2012; Stuart and Gillon 2013）。应对这些挑战需要多管齐下、多层次的方法：成千上万的个体农民采取行动，并辅以对新方法的研究、关于新兴实践和技术的教育，以及促进可持续性的政策。这类挑战被描述为“棘手问题”（wicked problems）（Batie 2008），因为与那些因果关系简单、主要可通过技术方案解决的问题相比，它们是动态的、复杂的，并且同时存在于技术和社会两个维度之中。在农业环境背景下，棘手问题之所以出现，是因为农业既是生态过程，也是社会经济过程。

title: Rational Exaggeration and Counter-Exaggeration in Information Aggregation Games
Sustainability and Substitutability
The Need for a Coupled Human and Natural Systems Understanding of Agricultural Nitrogen Loss
abstract: Reactive nitrogen loss from agricultural fertilizer use remains a crucial environmental problem in the United States, contributing to ecosystem degradation and global climate change. This intractable problem requires a coupled human and natural systems approach that combines biophysical, sociological, and economic knowledge into an integrative analysis. Much is known about the biogeochemistry of nitrogen and agricultural nitrogen loss; however, much is not known about how soil variability and climate change will affect farmer decisionmaking. Although it is widely understood that personal values and beliefs, social norms, economics, and policies influence farmer decisionmaking, very little is known about decisionmaking specific to fertilizer management. In addition, little is known about the socioeconomic influences on decisionmaking across scales and how ecological change is perceived and responded to. Combining sociological, economic, and biophysical knowledge can provide key insights regarding how these factors interact and can support more effective strategies to address this persistent problem.
abstract_zh: 农用化肥造成的活性氮损失，仍然是美国一个关键的环境问题，它导致生态系统退化并加剧全球气候变化。这一棘手问题需要一种耦合的人与自然系统方法，将生物物理学、社会学和经济学知识整合为综合分析。关于氮的生物地球化学过程和农业氮损失，我们已有诸多了解；然而，土壤变异性和气候变化将如何影响农民的决策，我们所知甚少。尽管人们普遍认为，个人价值观与信念、社会规范、经济状况和政策都会影响农民决策，但对于施肥管理方面的决策，我们了解得很少。此外，关于社会经济因素如何在不同尺度上影响决策，以及生态变化如何被感知和回应，我们的认识也很有限。将社会学、经济学和生物物理学知识结合起来，可以就这些因素如何相互作用提供关键洞见，并支持制定更有效的策略来应对这一持久存在的问题。

title: Understanding Behavioral Explanations of the WTP-WTA Divergence Through a Neoclassical Lens: Implications for Environmental Policy
abstract: The often observed empirical divergence between WTA and WTP measures of welfare change continues to be a topic of interest to both theoretical and applied economists. The divergence has particularly important implications for environmental policy. In this article, we review behavioral and other explanations of the disparity, with a focus on their connections to neoclassical welfare theory, and evaluate the empirical evidence of these explanations through the same lens. Some explanations of the disparity are consistent with neoclassical models, and some are not. Likewise, some imply that the divergences are attributed to underlying preferences (neoclassical or not), whereas others suggest that the divergences are due to elicitation methods, cognitive limitations, or other non-preference-related reasons. We argue that the source of the divergence can inform the choice of which measure, WTP or WTA, to use in a given empirical application.
abstract_zh: 在福利变化的衡量中，WTA与WTP之间经常被观察到的实证差异，始终是理论经济学家和应用经济学家共同关注的话题。这种差异对环境政策具有特别重要的意义。在本文中，我们回顾了对这一差异的行为学解释及其他解释，重点关注它们与新古典福利理论之间的联系，并以同样的视角评估这些解释的实证证据。一些解释与新古典模型相一致，另一些则不然。同样，一些解释认为这种差异归因于潜在偏好（新古典偏好或非新古典偏好），而另一些则认为这种差异源于测度方法、认知局限或其他与偏好无关的原因。我们认为，差异的来源可以为在特定实证应用中选择使用WTP还是WTA提供依据。

title: The Value of Clean Air in China: Evidence from Beijing and Shanghai
A dynamic explanation of the willingness to pay and willingness to accept disparity
Monopoly Extraction of a Nonrenewable Resource Facing Capacity Constrained Renewable Competition
Adaptation versus Adoption: with Emphasis on Climate Change
abstract: This article presents lessons from the rich adoption literature for the nascent research on adaptation. Individuals' adoption choices are affected by profit and risk considerations and by credit and biophysical constraints. New technologies spread gradually, reflecting heterogeneity among potential adopters, processes of learning and technological improvement, and policies and institutions. Adaptation is the response of economic agents and societies to major shocks. We distinguish between reactive and proactive adaptation. The latter is important in the context of climate change and consists of mitigation, reassessment, and innovation that aim to affect the timing and location of shocks. Adaptation strategies also include adoption of innovation and technology transfer across locations, insurance and international trade, and migration and invasions. Recent research emphasizes multidisciplinary collaborations; historical analysis; and the roles of returns to scale of key technologies, social networks, behavioral economics, path dependency, and ex ante adjustment in explaining patterns of adoption and adaptation.
abstract_zh: 本文总结了丰富的技术采用（adoption）文献对新兴的适应（adaptation）研究的启示。个体的采用选择受到利润与风险考量，以及信贷与生物物理约束的影响。新技术逐步扩散，这反映了潜在采用者之间的异质性、学习与技术改进的过程，以及政策和制度的作用。适应是经济主体和社会对重大冲击所作出的反应。我们区分了被动适应（reactive）与主动适应（proactive）。在气候变化背景下，后者尤为重要，它包括减缓、重新评估和创新，旨在影响冲击的时间和地点。适应策略还包括采用创新与跨地区技术转移、保险与国际贸易，以及移民和生物入侵。近期研究强调多学科合作、历史分析，以及关键技术的规模报酬、社会网络、行为经济学、路径依赖和事前调整在解释采用与适应模式中的作用。

International Environmental Agreements Emissions Trade, Safety Valves and Escape Clauses
abstract: We explain how the structure of multi-national or multi-regional environmental agreements affect their chance of success. Trade in emissions permits has ambiguous and in some cases surprising effects on both the equilibrium level of abatement, and on the ability to persuade nations or regions to participate in environmental agreements. An escape clause policy and a safety valve policy have essentially the same properties when membership in environmental agreement is pre-determined, but they create markedly different effects on the incentives to join such an agreement. The two policies lead to a qualitative difference in the leverage that a potential member of the agreement exercises on other members. JEL classification numbers C72, H4, Q54
abstract_zh: 我们解释了多国或多地区环境协议的结构如何影响其成功的可能性。排放许可交易对均衡减排水平以及说服各国或各地区参与环境协议的能力，都具有模糊的影响，在某些情况下甚至出人意料。在成员资格预先给定时，逃逸条款（escape clause）政策与安全阀（safety valve）政策具有基本相同的性质，但它们对加入此类协议的激励产生了截然不同的影响。这两种政策在潜在成员对其他成员施加的影响力（leverage）方面导致了质的差异。JEL分类号：C72, H4, Q54

Impact of Management Practices on Regional Prevalence of Soybean Sclerotinia Stem Rot in the North-Central Region of the United States and on Farmers' Decisions Under Uncertainty
abstract: Regional prevalence of soybean Sclerotinia stem rot (SSR), caused by Sclerotinia sclerotiorum, was modeled using management practices (tillage, herbicide, manure and fertilizer application, and seed treatment with fungicide) and summer weather variables (mean monthly air temperature and precipitation for the months of June, July, August, and September) as inputs. Logistic regression analysis was used to estimate the probability of stem rot prevalence with disease data from four states in the north-central region of the United States (Illinois, Iowa, Minnesota, and Ohio). Goodness-of-fit criteria indicated that the resulting model explained well the observed frequency of occurrence. The relationship of management practices and weather variables with soybean yield was examined using multiple linear regression (R 2 = 0.27). Variables significant to SSR prevalence, including average air temperature during July and August, precipitation during July, tillage, seed treatment, liquid manure, fertilizer, and herbicide applications, were also associated with high attainable yield. The results suggested that SSR occurrence in the north-central region of the United States was associated with environments of high potential yield. Farmers' decisions about SSR management, when the effect of management practices on disease prevalence and expected attainable yield was taken into account, were examined. Bayesian decision procedures were used to combine information from our model (prediction) with farmers' subjective estimation of SSR incidence (personal estimate, based on farmers' previous experience with SSR incidence). MAXIMIN and MAXIMAX criteria were used to incorporate farmers' site-specific past experience with SSR incidence, and optimum actions were derived using the criterion of profit maximization. Our results suggest that management practices should be applied to increase attainable yield despite their association with high disease risk.
abstract_zh: 我们以大豆菌核病茎腐病（Sclerotinia stem rot，SSR，由核盘菌Sclerotinia sclerotiorum引起）的区域流行情况为对象进行建模，模型输入包括管理措施（耕作、除草剂、粪肥和化肥施用，以及用杀菌剂进行种子处理）和夏季气象变量（6月、7月、8月和9月的月平均气温和降水量）。我们利用美国中北部地区四个州（伊利诺伊州、爱荷华州、明尼苏达州和俄亥俄州）的病害数据，采用逻辑回归估计茎腐病流行的概率。拟合优度指标表明，所得模型较好地解释了观测到的发生频率。我们使用多元线性回归考察管理措施和气象变量与大豆产量的关系（R² = 0.27）。与SSR流行相关的显著变量，包括7月和8月的平均气温、7月降水、耕作、种子处理、液体粪肥、化肥和除草剂施用，同时也与较高的可达产量相关。结果表明，美国中北部地区的SSR发生与高潜在产量的环境相关。在考虑管理措施对病害流行和预期可达产量的影响后，我们考察了农民关于SSR管理的决策。我们运用贝叶斯决策程序，将模型的预测信息与农民对SSR发病率的主观估计（个人估计，基于农民以往的SSR发病经验）相结合。我们运用MAXIMIN和MAXIMAX准则纳入农民基于具体地块的既往发病经验，并以利润最大化为准则推导最优行动。我们的结果表明，尽管管理措施与较高的病害风险相关，仍应采取这些管理措施以提高可达产量。

title: Irreversible Abatement Investment under Cost Uncertainties: Tradable Emission Permits and Emissions Charges
abstract: A major concern with TEPs is that stochastic permit prices may reduce firm incentive to invest in abatement capital or technologies relative to other policies such as a fixed emissions charge. However, under efficient permit trading, the price uncertainty is caused by abatement cost uncertainties which affect investment under both permit and charge policies. We develop a rational expectations general equilibrium model of permit trading and irreversible abatement investment to show how cost uncertainty affects investment. Differences between the effects of uncertainties under the two policies can be decomposed into a general equilibrium effect and a price-vs-quantity effect. After controlling for the assumption that the random variables enter the abatement cost function linearly, we find that uncertainties reduce both effects. In particular, firms' investment incentive decreases in cost uncertainties, but more so under emissions charges than under permits. Therefore, tradable permits in fact help maintain firms' investment incentive under uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 对于可交易排放许可（TEP）的一个主要担忧是，相对于固定排放费等其他政策，随机变化的许可价格可能会降低企业投资减排资本或技术的激励。然而，在有效的许可交易下，价格不确定性源于减排成本的不确定性，而这种成本不确定性在许可和收费两种政策下都会影响投资。我们建立了一个包含许可交易与不可逆减排投资的理性预期一般均衡模型，以说明成本不确定性如何影响投资。两种政策下不确定性效应之间的差异，可以分解为一般均衡效应和价格与数量效应。在控制了随机变量以线性方式进入减排成本函数这一假设后，我们发现不确定性会削弱这两种效应。具体而言，企业的投资激励随成本不确定性的增加而下降，但在排放收费下下降得比在许可制度下更多。因此，可交易许可实际上有助于在不确定性下维持企业的投资激励。

title: Policy Persistence in Environmental Regulation
The Long-run Effects of Environmental Reform in Open Economies
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: We compare the effects of environmental reform and harmonization in the short and the long run, under autarky and free trade. With trade, harmonization of policies, even if achieved by lowering standards in one country, can improve short run aggregate welfare and increase the likelihood of reaching a good long run equilibrium. However, long run considerations favor a "race to the top" rather than a "race to the bottom". Under autarky, unilateral reform may have no short run effect; it may have no qualitative long run effect if the environment regenerates slowly. Trade increases the likelihood that coordinated environmental reform can improve welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们比较了在自给自足和自由贸易两种情形下，环境改革与政策协调在短期和长期的效应。在存在贸易的情况下，即使政策协调是通过降低某一国的标准实现的，也可以改善短期总福利，并增加达到良好长期均衡的可能性。然而，长期考量更支持“向上竞争”（race to the top）而非“向下竞争”（race to the bottom）。在自给自足的情形下，单边改革可能没有短期效应；若环境再生速度缓慢，它也可能不会产生质的长期效应。贸易增加了协调性环境改革改善福利的可能性。

title: Notes on Irreversibility, Sustainability and the Limits to Growth
venue: Book chapter: Economic Theory for the Environment: Essays in Honour of Karl-Goran Maler

title: The Time Path and Implementation of Carbon Sequestration
abstract: We develop a dynamic model to investigate the optimal time paths of carbon emissions, sequestration, and the carbon stock. We show that carbon sinks should be utilized as early as possible, and carbon flow into sinks should last until the atmospheric carbon concentration is stabilized. We rule out any cyclical patterns of carbon sequestration and release. We propose and assess three mechanisms to efficiently introduce sequestration into a carbon permit trading market: a pay-as-you-go system, a variable-length-contract system and a carbon annuity account system. Although the three mechanisms may not be equally feasible to implement, they are all efficient.
abstract_zh: 我们建立了一个动态模型，以研究碳排放、碳汇（sequestration）和碳储量的最优时间路径。我们证明，碳汇应尽早加以利用，流入碳汇的碳应持续到大气碳浓度稳定为止。我们排除了碳固存与释放的任何周期性模式。我们提出并评估了三种将碳固存有效引入碳排放权交易市场的机制：现收现付制度、可变期限合约制度，以及碳年金账户制度。尽管三种机制的可行性程度不尽相同，但它们在效率上均是有效的。

title: Valuation and management of money-back guarantee options
A New Explanation for the WTP/WTA Disparity
Common Ground Between Free-Traders and Environmentalists
abstract: We use a North-South model with property right differences and resource dynamics to study the effects of trade on resource use and welfare. Autarky is likely to Pareto-dominate free trade in the long run when the environment is quite fragile, and the result is reversed when the environment is quite resilient. Trade may cause an environmentally poor country to "drag down" its richer trading partner; in this case, both countries degrade their stocks when these would be preserved under autarky. Alternatively, trade may enable the environmentally richer country to "pull up" its partner; in this case both countries preserve their stocks when these would be degraded under autarky. These results rationalize the positions of environmentalists and free-traders. The direction of trade may change over time, but in steady states it is either inefficient or indeterminate. In the former case, a switch to autarky would increase global welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个具有产权差异和资源动态的南北模型，研究贸易对资源利用和福利的影响。当环境十分脆弱时，长期来看自给自足很可能帕累托优于自由贸易；当环境具有较强韧性时，结论则相反。贸易可能使环境条件较差的国家“拖累”其更富裕的贸易伙伴；在这种情况下，原本在自给自足下能够保存的存量，在两国中都会被破坏。另一种情况是，贸易可能使环境条件较好的国家“拉动”其伙伴；在这种情况下，原本在自给自足下会被破坏的存量，在两国中都得以保存。这些结果为环保主义者和自由贸易主义者的立场提供了理论依据。贸易方向可能随时间变化，但在稳态下，它要么是无效率的，要么是不确定的。在前一种情形下，转向自给自足将提高全球福利。

title: Fixed Costs, Efficient Resource Management and Conservation
abstract: This article develops a framework to analyze the impacts on resource development of efficient management practices that account for possible resource conserving technological changes. Compared with the traditional management practice ignoring these changes, efficient management may not delay or reduce resource development, depending on the level of the changes. Under efficient management, a higher probability of resource conserving technologies may not delay or reduce resource development. These ambiguities are due to the existence of fixed and increasing marginal costs in resource development.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个框架，用以分析考虑到可能的资源节约型技术变革的高效管理实践，对资源开发的影响。与忽略这些变革的传统管理实践相比，高效管理未必会延迟或减少资源开发，这取决于变革的程度。在高效管理下，资源节约型技术出现的概率较高，未必会延迟或减少资源开发。这些不确定的结果源于资源开发中同时存在固定成本与递增的边际成本。

title: On the Long-Run Efficiency of Auctioned vs. Free Permits
Trade and Environmental Distortions: Coordinated Intervention
abstract: Free trade may not improve welfare when environmental distortions exist. We study the coordination of trade and environmental policies when the distortion is loose property rights governing resources. Using the dual approach of Dixit and Norman (1980), we trade out ‘iso-welfare’ curves in the space of the degree of environment distortion and the level of the import tariff. We use these curves to find necessary and sufficient conditions for disproportionate reforms, piecemeal or discrete, to be welfare improving. We also find that the needed reduction in the distortion to make trade welfare improving increases as the environmental stock increases, the productivity of the environmentally intensive good increases, or when the country is a large exporter of the environmentally intensive good.
abstract_zh: 当存在环境扭曲时，自由贸易未必能改善福利。我们研究当扭曲来自资源产权界定不清时，贸易政策与环境政策的协调问题。我们采用Dixit and Norman（1980）的对偶方法，在环境扭曲程度与进口关税水平构成的空间中消去变量，得到“等福利”曲线。利用这些曲线，我们找到了不成比例的改革（无论是分步进行还是一次性进行）能够改善福利的充分必要条件。我们还发现，当环境存量增加、环境密集型商品的生产率提高，或国家是环境密集型商品的大型出口国时，使贸易能够改善福利所需的扭曲减少幅度会相应增大。

title: Irreversibility and Restoration in Natural Resource Development
abstract: We extend Real Option Theory to evaluate natural resource development projects that may bring negative net benefits and require costly restoration. Based on a new concept, irreversibility cost, we show that the degree of irreversibility becomes an endogenous choice, rather than an exogenously given economic constraint. Fixed costs of restoration have continuous impacts, over and above the widely recognized fixed effects, on development and restoration levels (and the marginal q). The project's value may not necessarily be convex in the underlying random variable, and discounting may in fact encourage the pattern of developing now and restoring later.
abstract_zh: 我们扩展了实物期权理论，用以评估可能带来负净收益且需要昂贵修复的自然资源开发项目。基于“不可逆成本”这一新概念，我们证明不可逆程度成为一种内生选择，而非外生给定的经济约束。修复的固定成本对开发和修复水平（以及边际q值）产生连续性影响，这超出了人们普遍认识到的固定效应。项目价值未必是基础随机变量的凸函数，而且折现实际上可能助长“先开发、后修复”的模式。
